job.question: How many printed copies of the proposal must be submitted in the Boston Retirement System 2022 investment consulting services RFP?
job.expected_facts: Seven (7) printed copies plus one (1) electronic version.
job.acceptance: Seven printed copies alone answers the question; electronic copy is optional context.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2016 South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission RFP, not the Boston Retirement System 2022 RFP. Its requirement of one original and ten copies cannot support the requested printed-copy count.
